galatians.6.p1.b1.text: Brothers, if someone is caught in a trespass, you who are spiritual should restore him with a spirit of gentleness. …

galatians.6.p1.b2.text: Carry one another’s burdens, and in this way you will fulfill the law of Christ.

galatians.6.p1.b3.text: If anyone thinks he is something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.

galatians.6.p2.b1.text: Do not be deceived: God is not to be mocked. Whatever a man sows, he will reap in return.

galatians.6.p2.b2.text: … the one who sows to please the Spirit, from the Spirit will reap eternal life.

galatians.6.p2.b3.text: Let us not grow weary in well-doing, for in due time we will reap a harvest if we do not give up.

galatians.6.p2.b4.text: Therefore, as we have opportunity, let us do good to everyone, and especially to the family of faith.

galatians.6.p3.b1.text: See what large letters I am using to write to you with my own hand!

galatians.6.p3.b2.text: Those who want to make a good impression outwardly are trying to compel you to be circumcised. They only do this to avoid persecution for the cross of Christ.

galatians.6.p3.b3.text: … they want you to be circumcised that they may boast in your flesh.

galatians.6.p4.b1.text: But as for me, may I never boast, except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ …

galatians.6.p4.b2.text: For neither circumcision nor uncircumcision means anything. What counts is a new creation.

galatians.6.p4.b3.text: Peace and mercy to all who walk by this rule, even to the Israel of God.

galatians.6.p5.b1.text: From now on let no one cause me trouble, for I bear on my body the marks of Jesus.

galatians.6.p5.b2.text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. Amen.
